about: science-factory/mvp/gain.py (power under an unflagged gross error)
text: After the quality screen, one pass the product does not flag (2024-03-26, residual +0.86 m) carries about 70 percent of the residual sum of squares in the 2024 record. The interval still covers (the required gross-error cases: coverage 0.93), but the rule's power to support a true claim falls from about 0.95 in a kind case to about 0.49 when such passes occur. Proposed for the method work: a robust estimator written into the plan, or a plan that states the power it has when a gross error is present. Found by the second review pass.
